acceptOwnership().details: The new owner accepts the ownership transfer.

params._usdc: ERC-20 token address used for settlement.

params.deadline: Optional deadline timestamp (0 means no deadline).
params.escrowType: Escrow payout mode: single-release or multi-release.
params.roles: Role assignments used for approvals, release, disputes, and fee routing.

fundEscrow(uint256,uint256).details: Only escrow participants can fund: approver, service provider, release signer, and platform address (when set).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pendingOwner().details: Returns the address of the pending owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.distributions: Recipients and net amounts that must sum to dispute net balance.
Recipients and net amounts that must sum to milestone net balance.

params.bps: New protocol fee in basis points (max 500).

transferOwnership(address).details: Starts the ownership transfer of the contract to a new account. Replaces the pending transfer if there is one. Can only be called by the current owner. Setting `newOwner` to the zero address is allowed; this can be used to cancel an initiated ownership transfer.

params.newPlatformFeeBps: New platform fee in basis points.

withdrawRemainingFunds(uint256,(address,.details: Callable by dispute resolver, approver, or release signer.

approveMilestone(uint256,uint256,bytes32.notice: Marks a milestone as approved and optionally records evidence.

changeMilestoneStatus(uint256,uint256,ui.notice: Updates milestone progress state and optional evidence hash.

depositOf(uint256,address).notice: Returns deposited amount for a depositor in a given escrow.

disputeEscrow(uint256).notice: Raises a dispute on a single-release escrow.

disputeMilestone(uint256,uint256).notice: Raises a dispute on one milestone of a multi-release escrow.

escrowsByAddress(address).notice: Returns escrow ids associated with an address.

fundEscrow(uint256,uint256).notice: Funds an escrow by transferring USDC from caller into contract custody.

fundedTotal(uint256).notice: Returns total funded amount for an escrow.

getEscrow(uint256).notice: Returns the escrow struct for an id.

getMilestones(uint256).notice: Returns all milestones for an escrow.

getRoles(uint256).notice: Returns role assignments for an escrow.

refundAfterDeadline(uint256).notice: Refunds remaining escrow balance pro-rata to depositors after deadline.

releaseFunds(uint256).notice: Releases a fully approved single-release escrow.

releaseMilestoneFunds(uint256,uint256).notice: Releases one approved milestone from a multi-release escrow.

rescueFunds(address,uint256).notice: Rescues surplus USDC above tracked obligations.

resolveDispute(uint256,(address,uint256).notice: Resolves a single-release escrow dispute using explicit net distributions.

resolveMilestoneDispute(uint256,uint256,.notice: Resolves a disputed milestone in a multi-release escrow using explicit net distributions.

setFee(uint16,address).notice: Updates protocol fee configuration for newly created escrows.

withdrawRemainingFunds(uint256,(address,.notice: Withdraws residual escrow balance after full release lifecycle, without additional fees.
